identity.headline: I build web products, developer tools and open-source experiments.
identity.summary: Software developer focused on TypeScript, Next.js and Node. I build web products, internal tooling and open-source experiments — usually the kind that turn a messy manual process into something a browser can do in one click.
identity.languagePreference: English for code and docs, Portuguese natively

projects.name: rebar
projects.summary: Repository checker and merge gate for projects written with AI agents. Audits any repository, scans versioned files for known prompt-injection signatures, and blocks the commit when a rule is ignored. Zero runtime dependencies.

projects.name: OpenKartline
projects.summary: Racing-line planner and lap-time estimator that runs in the browser. Draw or import a kart track, pick a class, and get a baseline line, braking points and an estimated lap time — a planning estimate, not a validated one.

projects.name: OpenParts
projects.summary: Local-first parts interchange lab. Cross-reference automotive part numbers entirely in the browser, with no backend to depend on.

projects.name: Constellation
projects.summary: An observatory for public GitHub signals — profiles, achievements and activity, measured honestly instead of gamified.

projects.name: Galegos
projects.summary: Digital menu that hands the finished order off to WhatsApp. Built for a real kitchen, so it had to survive real customers.

projects.name: Speech → Text Translator
projects.summary: Real-time speech-to-text translation running straight in the browser.

projects.name: Realistic Injuries
projects.summary: FiveM mod that models injuries per body region instead of a single health bar.
